app.name: Qari
app.tagline: Your book, for your eyes only

meta.title: Qari — your book, for your eyes only
meta.description: Read the book you bought after signing in, chapter by chapter, with no files to download or forward.

home.title: Your book, for your eyes only
home.lead: Read the book you bought after signing in, chapter by chapter, with no files to download or forward.

login.title: No password to remember
login.body: Enter your email and we send you a code to sign in with.

resume.title: Pick up where you left off
resume.body: Your reading position, font size and night mode are saved.

personal.title: Your copy, in your name
personal.body: Your name appears faintly on every page, because this copy is yours alone.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Enter the email you bought the book with and we'll send you a sign-in code.
login.codeSent: If this email has a Qari account, we've sent it a message. Open the link in it, or type the code if there is one. Check your spam folder too.

errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't complete that right now. Try again shortly.
errors.link: That sign-in link didn't work: it may have expired or been opened in a different browser from the one that asked for it. Ask for a new link and open it in the same browser.

library.title: My library
library.empty: There are no books in your library yet. If you just bought one, it can take a few minutes to appear.

errors.notEntitled: This book isn't in your library.
errors.deviceLimit: This account is already open on two devices, which is the limit. Contact us to remove an old device.
errors.deviceRevoked: This device was removed from your account. Contact us if that's a mistake.
errors.inactive: This account is suspended. Contact us if that's a mistake.
errors.generic: We couldn't open this page right now. Try again shortly.

admin.title: Owner panel
admin.name: Name (shown in the watermark)
admin.linked: Reader added and the book is open to them. They sign in with their email and a code.
admin.invited: Reader invited. The book opens when they first sign in with their email and a code.
admin.noBooks: There are no books yet. Import the book first.

salla.title: Salla link
salla.lead: Link a Salla product SKU to a book. The book unlocks for the buyer after payment and locks again on cancellation or refund.
